detail: Clean main at e230a81c; homelab nodes/workloads ready; health/live, health/ready, and health/version returned 200.

Baseline suites executed before source changes: quality gate passed; frontend lint/type-check/build passed; frontend full suite and backend non-integration suite have baseline failures recorded in baseline.md.
probe_slack prefers settings.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN over the DB-resolved global webhook config; the supplied DB webhook is reported auth_error when the bot-token placeholder is present.
Settings(CORS_ORIGINS_RAW=...) is overridden by the dotenv alias CORS_ORIGINS, so public_base_url resolves to the local default instead of the supplied ingress origin.
Made runtime DB-resolved Slack webhook authoritative over stale environment bot-token settings.
Existing regression test now passes after the fail-first fix.
